items.title: Critical Zero-Click Command Injection in AVideo Platform Allows Stream Hijacking
items.description: A critical vulnerability in AVideo, a widely used open-source video hosting and streaming platform. Tracked as CVE-2026-29058, this zero-click flaw carries a maximum severity rating, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the targeted server.
